status_note: Filed by the E25 agent before the run under the user's 2026-10-22 instruction (plan reports/2026-10-22_plan_small-update-reruns.md, approved class 2). Never edited after the run; changes go in a dated report.
design: reports/2026-10-22_plan_small-update-reruns.md -> E25 step_split_small and Agent notes; parent E19 reports/2026-10-21_plan_step-split.md

setup.paths: emoticon full fine-tune, arm A (batch 32, clip 1.0, seed 0, 24 matrices), 1000 steps: plain SGD lr 0.01 and Adam lr 3e-6 (E21's matched pair, experiments/sgd_finetune)
setup.step_split: as E19: after every optimizer step, per matrix, S_t = W_t - W_(t-1) split by split.StepSplit (carry=True): pieces c_t (S_t V, S_t^T U) against the current alive (U, V), c_t refitted each step on W0's input moments, Delta takes the rest incl. dU dV^T; the fixed-bases twin (carry=False) beside it for consistency numbers only; float32 on the GPU; Gamma frozen
setup.references: do-nothing and the one-shot least-squares split (split.split_state) of the same delta-W, same job
setup.measure: harness.measure at steps 10, 100, 1000 per path: route split (e_delta, unmasked P(target) U1), held-out P(target) T1, Delta's share of ||delta-W||^2 (delta_change_frac), Pile ratios to W0 at adversary seed 0 (256 rows, 20 PGD steps)
setup.floor_and_verdict: f = max/min - 1 of W0's PGD KL over adversary seeds 0, 1 (same job); faith_score.verdict: pass <= 1.5 / (1 + f), fail >= 1.5 (1 + f), inconclusive between
setup.split_numbers: commute.step_split.numbers per scored step: Delta share plain and input-weighted for carried bases, fixed bases and the one-shot adjoint split (1 - R); largest relative change of any write/read vector (carried, fixed); accumulated second-order share of Delta's weighted change

control_first.arm: W0 under the Pile harness at adversary seeds 0 and 1, before any fine-tune
control_first.rule: faith_score.w0_check: seed-0 PGD KL within 10% of 0.69 (relative), CI-masked within 2% of 0.348 (relative), floor f <= 0.25 (absolute); otherwise the job stops with nothing scored
control_first.expected: PGD 0.69, CI-masked 0.348; f 0.21 on an L40, 0.075 on E16's H100, unknown on the RunPod card
control_first.blind_to: anything about the updates; it checks the harness only

positive_control.rule: after optimizer step 1, per path, max over matrices of ||dU_carry - dU_fixed|| / ||dU_fixed|| (and V) <= 1e-6 (absolute)
positive_control.expected: exactly 0: both split the same step against W0's bases
positive_control.if_fail: the step split's carrying is wrong; P1 unscored
positive_control.blind_to: every later step, where carried and fixed bases differ by construction

gates.rule: per path, step-10 rel_norm_max within 1% (relative) of sgd_finetune's: SGD 0.0023841 (results/split.json finetune_eval.sgd), Adam 3e-6 0.0022342 (results/adam_matched.json grid['3e-06'])
gates.expected: within 0.1% (only bf16 kernels differ between cards)
gates.if_fail: the job stops: the path is not E21's update

gates.rule: per path, step-10 do-nothing adversarial ratio within max(f, 0.209) (absolute) of sgd_finetune's: SGD 1.1217, Adam 3e-6 1.0847 (both read on the L40 under its floor 0.209; as E22's G1)
gates.expected: about 1.1 on any card; a miss with G1_rel_norm met is the card's floor, read and reported, not a stop

gates.rule: per path and step: the step-split state's held-out P(target) T1 within 1e-3 of the fine-tune's own eval; route shares sum to 1 within 1e-6; harness delta_change_frac within 1e-3 of step_split.numbers' delta_share
gates.if_fail: the state is not the fine-tuned model; P1 unscored
gates.blind_to: where inside the model the behaviour runs

predictions.claim: Delta's share of ||delta-W||^2 under the step split is lower on the SGD path than on the Adam 3e-6 path at every scored step
predictions.rule: delta_change_frac(step split, SGD) < delta_change_frac(step split, Adam 3e-6) at steps 10, 100 and 1000 (absolute comparison, no margin; the shares are deterministic given the state)
predictions.why: an SGD step is a clipped gradient and SGD component training reproduces its adjoint split (cosine 0.957, E21 sgd_finetune P5), so each SGD step should be closer to what the pieces can take; Adam rescales coordinates and spreads the step (outside share 0.157 vs SGD's 0.034 at step 10)
predictions.expected: SGD about 0.4-0.9, Adam 3e-6 about 0.9-1.2 (E19's large Adam path read 1.03, 1.05, 1.21)
predictions.null: the per-step scale refit decides the share whatever the optimiser: SGD at or above Adam at some step
predictions.noise_floor: card-to-card differences in the fine-tune (bf16 kernels), about 1e-3 of the share
predictions.blind_to: where the behaviour runs and the Pile

predictions.claim: the step-split state's adversarial verdict at step 1000 on each small path, beside E19's large-path fail (2.67)
predictions.rule: faith_score.verdict(Pile PGD ratio of the step-split state at step 1000, f); outcome per path: 'fails like E19' (fail), 'passes, unlike E19' (pass), 'inconclusive'
predictions.expected: no direction filed: the small do-nothing states pass at step 10 (E21) but the step split's Delta held more energy than the update on the large path by step 1000
predictions.noise_floor: f from the same job's W0 seeds; one adversary seed per state
predictions.blind_to: the trained behaviour; a 20-step adversary only (E20 Amendment 2: far from its maximum)

predictions.claim: the behaviour kept in the pieces under the step split, against the least-squares split of the same delta-W
predictions.rule: per path and step: P(target) with every component on and Delta out (route split p_cells U1) for the step-split state minus the same for the least-squares state; outcome 'same' if |diff| < 0.05 (absolute), else 'less in the pieces' or 'more in the pieces'. e_delta of both states reported beside it (E19's reading), not scored
predictions.expected: no direction filed. E19's large path: U1 0.966 / 0.942 / 0.806 for the step split against 0.998 / 0.995 / 0.984 for least squares (this rule would read 'same', 'less', 'less'); e_delta 0.31 / 0.37 / 0.61 against 0.09 / 0.15 / 0.31
predictions.noise_floor: deterministic given the state; card differences about 1e-3
predictions.blind_to: the Pile; what Delta's change does when it is left in

reported_not_scored: do-nothing and least-squares verdicts at every step; the plain and weighted Delta shares for fixed bases and the one-shot adjoint split (E19: per-step scale refit pushed the weighted share to 1.38 at step 1000 against 0.69 one-shot); piece_change_max (E19 0.037 / 0.048 / 0.127); second-order shares (E19 <= 1e-7); stochastic, CI-masked and unmasked Pile ratios
